notes.title: New game! - Historical Fashion Dress Up 🩷
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692430/Historical_Fashion_Dress_Up/

Hi everyone!

Last week we launched our newest game, [b][i]Historical Fashion Dress Up[/i][/b]! A unique dress up with historically accurate fashion. If you enjoyed playing The Widow’s Boutique and you want more 1820s content, [i]Historical Fashion Dress Up [/i]is the game for you!

[i]Historical Fashion Dress Up[/i] is a “love letter” to fashion history. All garments are made based on fashion plates, contemporary painting and preserved garments from various museum collections. 
The first packs are dedicated to 1820s fashion, with more content and time periods to come! 

[previewyoutube=pJ3n-Jc7kG4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Historical Fashion Dress Up Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Play with 1820s fashion
[*] Customise your character
[*] Attend different events
[*] Build your wardrobe
[*] Print out paper dolls
[/list]
[i]A casual and captivating experience for historical fashion enthusiasts![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220139/5f8a58600cd88cc1c09cb8c1df7ed3e2c24f4da5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220139/16b01179c3867d308639b4dab01c083b048c99cc.png[/img]

Thank you for playing!
- Tidvis Games

notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone! [/h1]

The Widow's Boutique is launching on [b]March 8th[/b], on the International Women's Day. We see this as a good launch date for a game about a woman in business in the 1820´s!

Make sure to wishlist the game so you can be notified when it's out!

notes.title: Updated demo!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone! [/h1]

We have added a new intro and expanded on the demo, letting you play for two additional turns. This means you get to explore more of the world and dive deeper into the plot. The demo is still just a small part of the full game, so stay tuned for more updates.
